description: Rungs where closurec's output differs from the pinned oracle. Each entry pins the current closurec output so the gap cannot silently widen, and so closing it fails the harness — which is the signal to delete the entry.

ladder_t3_function_expr_advanced.reason: closurec does not propagate a single-use function expression to its call site and eliminate the binding.

ladder_t3_iife_advanced.reason: closurec does not inline an immediately invoked function expression.

ladder_t3_nested_fn_advanced.reason: closurec does not inline a single-use nested function. `inline` is registered only under ADVANCED, and even there handles a narrower case than upstream.

ladder_t3_nested_fn_simple.reason: closurec does not inline a single-use nested function. `inline` is registered only under ADVANCED, and even there handles a narrower case than upstream.

ladder_t3_unused_local_advanced.reason: closurec does not remove a function-local binding that is never read. `remove-unused-vars` is gated to ADVANCED, but upstream removes scope-local bindings at SIMPLE too, where the open-world contract does not apply.

ladder_t3_unused_local_simple.reason: closurec does not remove a function-local binding that is never read. `remove-unused-vars` is gated to ADVANCED, but upstream removes scope-local bindings at SIMPLE too, where the open-world contract does not apply.
